noEngines.title: Install an AI engine to get started
noEngines.intro: {app} doesn't ship a model of its own — your bots run on an AI CLI installed on this computer, using your existing login. Set up any one of these and your bots come alive.
approval.voice.skill: {requester} asks: {title} Review the skill on screen. Should I {action} it?
approval.voice.profile: {requester} wants to update its profile: {title}. Review the change on screen. Should I confirm it?
approval.voice.command: {requester} wants to {tool}. {detail}. Should I allow it?
approval.voice.routine: {requester} asks: {title} Review the schedule and instructions on screen. Should I confirm it?
approval.held.native: The provider requires your approval for this action.
approval.held.sandbox: This changes the provider sandbox, so only Full access can approve it automatically.
approval.held.localComputer: Controlling your computer is never covered by Always allow, so this needs you.
approval.held.unattended: A webhook or another bot started this turn, so Approve for me is paused and every action asks.
approval.held.unattendedFullAccess: A webhook or another bot started this turn, so Approve for me is paused and every action asks. Full access keeps working unattended.
approval.held.destructive: This looks destructive, so Approve for me stopped to ask.
approval.held.sensitive: This touches credentials, so Approve for me stopped to ask.
approval.held.needsYou: This action needs you, so Approve for me stopped to ask.
approval.held.undeliveredFull: Full access couldn't deliver this approval.
approval.held.undelivered: Approve for me couldn't answer this one.
settings.title: Settings
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.subtitle: Shown in the sidebar. Saved as you go.
settings.profile.name: Your name
settings.skin.title: Skin
settings.skin.subtitle: Applies instantly and is remembered on this machine.
settings.roomTurns.title: Channel turns
settings.roomTurns.subtitle: Set one maximum duration for every bot turn in a channel.
settings.roomTurns.label: Maximum turn length
settings.roomTurns.help: Applies to every bot turn in channels. Direct chats use the inactivity watchdog instead.
settings.roomTurns.error: Could not save the channel turn limit.
settings.roomTurns.range: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,440.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.subtitle: The app follows your system language unless you pick one here. Only part of the interface is translated so far — untranslated text stays in English.
settings.toolCalls.title: Tool calls
settings.toolCalls.subtitle: Show each tool a bot runs in the transcript. Off by default — the mascot already shows that work is happening.
settings.toolCalls.detail: Named chips for Bash, search, and other tools. Errors and bot-to-bot messages still appear.
settings.toolCalls.error: Could not save the tool-call setting.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.updates.latest: You're on the latest version we know of.
settings.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
settings.diagnostics.subtitle: Versions, configuration on/off state and redacted server, desktop and updater log tails. Review the file before sharing it.
settings.diagnostics.aria: Export diagnostics to a text file
settings.analytics.title: Usage analytics
settings.analytics.subtitle: Anonymous product events — app opened, which features get used. Never conversations, prompts, file contents, or bot output. Your email is only attached if you shared it during setup.
settings.updates.preparing: Download complete. macOS is preparing the update.
settings.updates.handedOff: Command copied — finish the update in your terminal.
